senses.gloss: मघा- + भव मघा- + भव, m. the planet Venus.

मघ मघ (cf. मह्),
 I. n.
 1. Power, wealth (ved.).
 2. A kind of flower.
 II. m.
 1. One of the Dvīpas or divisions of the universe.
 2. Pleasure.
 III. f. घा (usually pl.), The tenth lunar asterism, Man. 3, 273; Sund. 2, 2.
 IV. f. घा or घी, A sort of grain.

माघ माघ, m.
 1. A month, January--February, Pañc. 169, 6.
 2. The name of a poet.

मघवन् मघवन्, a curtailed form of the next.
 I. adj., f. घोनी, Wealthy, Chr. 287, 2 = Rigv. i. 48, 2.
 II. m. Indra, Vikr. 86, 19.

मघवन्त् मघ + वन्त्,
 I. adj. Wealthy. m. A sacrificer, Chr. 291, 14 = Rigv. i. 64, 14.
 II. m. Indra, Vikr. 88, 21.
माघवत माघवत, i. e. मघवन्त् + अ, adj. Belonging to Indra, Utt. Rāmac. 124, 11 (-चाप, the rainbow).
माघवन माघवन, i. e. मघवन् + अ, adj., f. नी, Ruled by Indra, Śiś. 9, 25.
